advisories.title: Critical PHP vulnerabilities: update web-serving runtimes
advisories.summary: PHP has released fixes for two vulnerabilities that can allow unauthenticated remote code execution. FrankenPHP is among the affected web-serving runtimes. No automatic remediation package has been published in this catalog yet.
affected: PHP installations serving web requests, including PHP-FPM, mod_php, CGI, FrankenPHP and LiteSpeed.
Package versions require vendor-aware assessment: distributions may backport fixes.
recommendations: Update to PHP 8.2.35, 8.3.36, 8.4.27 or 8.5.12, or a later supported release containing these fixes; consult the distribution vendor for backported packages.
For container deployments, use a verified patched image and replace the running containers. Downloading an image alone does not update the serving runtime.
Confirm the active web runtime after replacement. Temporary mitigations are incomplete; follow the upstream advisory.
